content:
olivia: Heads-up — small doc tweak for dedicated provisioning page. Found a confusing line about tenant labels and a shell snippet that doesn't run.
kevin: Can you paste the snippet here? I can try to fix the sed/jq one-liner.
olivia: Sure — current snippet on the page is:```bash
curl -sS https://api.redwood.ai/dedicated/provision | jq '.tenants[] | .label'
```When I run it I get authentication errors and jq returns nothing.
kevin: Two quick problems: 1) need an Authorization header, 2) path should be `.tenants[]?.labels` (the field is plural). Try:```bash
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/dedicated/provision | jq '.tenants[]?.labels'
```That returns the label list for me.
maria: Thanks — I'll open a tiny PR to clean wording and swap the shell snippet for a kubeconfig sample + a safe curl example. Who can review?
aj: :thumbsup: I can review. Also suggest a short note about isolation decorators and how they affect eviction.
sam: Is this going to touch SLA wording? We should avoid changing legal phrasing.
maria: No SLA changes — just clarifying language: replace "no eviction guarantee" with "best-effort eviction protection for reserved pools" and add parenthetical linking to SLA doc.
docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4321 by maria — 1 commit, 3 files changed
kevin: FYI the SDK snippet still references ruby client v0.6 in examples. Please bump to v0.9 in the same PR.
olivia: Also spotted a stale link to the autoscale runbook (404).
maria: I'll update that to the internal path /eng-releases/autoscale-runbook and add a redirect note.
aj: For the k8s sample please use this minimal config so it's copy-paste safe:```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: tenant-config
data:
  TENANT_LABEL: "team-x"
```
kevin: LGTM. Add a CLI example too: `rwctl dedicated create --tenant team-x --labels team-x`
maria: Added both to the PR. Quick QA checklist I'm running through: verify the internal link, run both shell and yaml snippets locally, update SDK version in examples, and add a one-liner about isolation decorators. Tagging reviewers @aj @kevin.
aj: Reviewed and left one inline wording suggestion at line 42.
kevin: Fixed the curl auth and jq path in the PR; updated ruby client version example to v0.9.
maria: Thanks — merging once CI passes.
deploy-bot: docs site deploy scheduled: build 789 -> staging (checkout PR 4321) :rocket:
olivia: Checked staging. Snippets render, links work. One nit: code fences need explicit language for highlight (bash/yaml).
maria: Good catch, I updated fence markers.
kevin: All green from my side.
maria: Merged and backported the small wording change to the dedicated-provisioning fragment. Closing this thread. Thanks all!
